name: Conspiracy / Political Thriller
definition: A protagonist uncovers coordinated hidden power while institutions, compromised information, and escalating surveillance narrow the space for action.
negative_signals: ordinary electoral disagreement without concealed coercion
diagnostic_questions: Does the danger grow as the protagonist understands the system?
Is control of information as important as physical force?

neighbors.distinction: Conspiracy expands from a discovery into a struggle against organized power.
Conspiracy hides domination inside a recognizable order; dystopia makes oppressive order overt.

reader_promises.name: Hidden system
reader_promises.description: Reveal that apparently separate events are connected by an intelligible structure of power.

reader_promises.name: Narrowing options
reader_promises.description: Make every gain in knowledge reduce safe allies, routes, or institutions.

roles.name: Witness or investigator
roles.description: Finds a discrepancy and chooses whether to pursue it despite mounting cost.

roles.name: Compromised insider
roles.description: Provides access while carrying divided loyalty or responsibility.

roles.name: Network face
roles.description: Represents the conspiracy without necessarily controlling its entire structure.

movements.name: Discrepancy
movements.description: Expose a fact that the official account cannot comfortably explain.

movements.name: Network emerges
movements.description: Connect incidents to people, incentives, and institutions without making the system omnipotent.

movements.name: Isolation
movements.description: Remove trusted channels through betrayal, intimidation, disbelief, or legal pressure.

movements.name: Countermove
movements.description: Force a public, covert, or sacrificial action that changes who controls the truth.

complications.name: Disinformation
complications.description: Accurate evidence is surrounded by plausible false material that damages credibility.

complications.name: Compromised ally
complications.description: A helper acts under leverage, divided duty, or prior involvement.

complications.name: Legal capture
complications.description: Rules and procedures are used to delay, isolate, or criminalize disclosure.

twists.name: Decoy center
twists.description: The apparent mastermind is a visible shield for a broader incentive structure.

twists.name: Protagonist used
twists.description: The investigation itself advances one faction's plan without erasing protagonist agency.

conclusions.name: Public exposure
conclusions.description: Evidence reaches an audience capable of changing the balance of power.

conclusions.name: Limited victory
conclusions.description: One operation is stopped while the larger system survives in altered form.

conclusions.name: Truth buried
conclusions.description: The protagonist preserves testimony or conscience even though power contains the revelation.

variation_axes.question: How large is the hidden system?

subversions: Make the conspiracy powerful through ordinary incentives rather than total control.
Let an apparent antagonist become the only credible witness.
cliches_to_avoid: An all-powerful network that can do anything except stop the protagonist
A data dump that replaces dramatized discovery
quality_checks: Every expansion of the conspiracy follows evidence already encountered.
Institutional power has specific mechanisms and limits.
The climax changes access to truth or power, not merely body count.

sources.title: The Cambridge Companion to Popular Fiction
sources.contribution: Treats suspense and crime as flexible repertoires shaped by reader expectations.

sources.title: On Some Properties of Science Fiction Dystopian Narrative
sources.contribution: Supports distinctions involving surveillance, centralized power, and systemic oppression.
